text: Meet Schritt. One calm, playful app for learning languages, music, and math.
The home page welcomes you with seventeen languages from around the world, and short lessons that fit into your day.
Our mission is simple: make a great start free, playful, and private. Our vision: learning that fits into five minutes, and feels good enough that you come back tomorrow.
Six values guide everything we build. Free for everyone. Respect for your attention. Private by default. Honest about limits. Open to everyone. And playful on purpose.
Our products. The Schritt app, with languages, math, and music, every level free. And an optional music studio, that turns a prompt into a song.
Now, let's step inside the app.
Choose from seventeen languages, from German and Spanish, to Japanese, Hindi, and Arabic. Each has six levels, from A one to C two.

Every lesson mixes listening, matching, building sentences, and typing. Your coach cheers you on, tap your answer, and see right away how you did. Right answers earn experience, and wrong ones teach you what to fix.
Switch to math, with three hundred sixty lessons, from first grade, all the way to twelfth.
Each lesson starts with a simple idea, then pictures, number lines, and shapes. Type your answer, even a fraction, and Schritt checks it for you, while your coach and friends cheer you on.
Music teaches you to read notes, keep rhythm, and understand keys, scales, and chords.
Tap play, listen, and name the note you see on the staff.
And in Studio, describe the music you imagine, in any language, and an AI model composes it, on your own computer.
Schritt. Languages, music, and math. Free for everyone. Learn a little, every day.
